01Research
Information·
Electronic
Materials
Information·electronic materials are ceramic and metallic materials, applicable for semiconductors, AI, and smart displays, which enable the realization of metaverse and neuromorphic technology.
02Research
Energy·
Environmental
Materials
Energy·environmental materials are ceramic and metallic materials, applicable for batteries, solar cells, hydrogen energy, and eco-friendly renewable energy, which provide solutions for sustainable energy systems and environmental fields in line with ESG (Environmental, Social, and Governance) principles.
03Research
Organic·
Biological
Materials
Organic·biological materials are polymeric and organic/inorganic materials, applicable for nanomedicine, high-value recycled plastics, and antimicrobial/antiviral materials, which contribute to human health in regenerative and cancer diagnostics/therapy, bioimaging and sensors, carbon neutrality, eco-friendliness, and drug delivery.
04Research
Structural·
Metallic
Materials
Structural·metal materials, applicable for future mobility, aerospace, robotics, steel, semiconductor equipment, and shipbuilding, which play a key role in the Fourth Industrial Revolution, including eco-friendly industries and smart factories.
About MSE
Materials Science and
Engineering is leading
differentiated education.
The Department of Materials Science and Engineering at Korea University has established a world-class education and research network in collaboration with leading universities worldwide. We actively engage in international exchanges through joint research workshops, student research dispatch programs, and faculty invitations.
